messages.lang_rich_block: 🎭 Character Styles • Русский — Gentle and supportive assistant. • Беларуская — Cozy fox-girl assistant in traditional vyshyvanka. • English — Crisp, modern digital health assistant. • Мемный — Relatable humor, irony and litres of coffee. • Киберпанк 2077 — Cyberware diagnostics and neon telemetry.
messages.help_rich_items: • /sos — 1-tap emergency headache logger. • /stats — Smart analytics & trigger radar. • /log — Record a migraine or headache attack. • /status — Check if your active episode has resolved. • /calendar — Interactive monthly calendar of headache days. • /export — Download detailed clinical PDF or CSV export. • /reminder — Configure daily wellness check-in notifications. • /language — Change language and assistant personality. • /donate — Support project infrastructure & development. • /menu — Open the bot's interactive main menu.
messages.donate_rich_block: KitsuMed is a free, independent, open-source headache and migraine tracker. Your donations help us cover server infrastructure, database hosting, and ongoing development of smart clinical tools, reports for neurologists, and charming kitsune artwork! Accepts International cards (Visa/Mastercard EUR/USD), CIS cards, and cryptocurrency (TON).
